title: Authoritative exact-SKU inventory evidence head acquisition
selectedSlice: Phase A: independent acquisition primitive; exactly three additions
purpose: Originate an authoritative exact-SKU evidence head and its opaque consistency bookmark without an earlier composition.

relationshipTo006N.reason: 006N validates an earlier composedCutoff and cannot serve as unconditional initial acquisition.
relationshipTo006N.unchanged: Existing 006N source, tests, specification and public contracts remain unchanged.
relationshipTo006N.temporaryDuplication: The small acquisition mechanism deliberately mirrors 006N. Differential tests protect compatibility; this phase does not establish one shared implementation.
relationshipTo006N.phaseB: Shared extraction requires separate review. Preserve 006N H>C returning stale without bookmark access, even when bookmark acquisition would fail.

contract.request: Exactly { sku: { id: FoodSkuId, version: positive safe integer } }; canonical parseFoodSkuId and validateFoodVersion; no normalization.
contract.unexpectedKeys: Reject unexpected own keys including composedCutoff before session access.
contract.acquired: { outcome: acquired, value: { sku: { id, version }, exactSkuEvidenceHead: H, bookmark } }; no redundant token object.
contract.invalid: Malformed request, exact SKU or canonical identity/version; no database access.
contract.storage-failure: Session, prepare, bind, query, malformed result/head, or bookmark failure; no partial value or escaping storage exception.
contract.composedCutoff: Not accepted, manufactured, inferred or compared.
contract.stale: No stale outcome or earlier-composition comparison.

authoritativeReadPoint.query: SELECT MAX(evidence_sequence) AS evidence_head FROM food_inventory_evidence_sequence WHERE sku_id COLLATE BINARY = ? AND sku_version = ?
authoritativeReadPoint.firstQuery: The exact-SKU head query is the first executed query on the session; no earlier metadata/global/schema query or bookmark access.
authoritativeReadPoint.headParsing: Match 006N exactly: success !== false; exactly one result row; object/nonarray row with own evidence_head; null or undefined maps to H=0, otherwise positive safe integer only. Numeric zero and coercible values fail.
authoritativeReadPoint.exactScope: H is the exact target SKU ID/version MAX, never a global maximum. Global gaps and higher unrelated-SKU sequences do not invalidate it.
authoritativeReadPoint.bookmarkOrdering: getBookmark only after successful head execution, result validation and head parsing.
authoritativeReadPoint.bookmark: Opaque nonempty string preserved exactly without trimming or internal parsing. Consistency anchor associated with the completed authoritative exact-SKU head read.

immutability: Fresh frozen acquired envelope, value and SKU; retain no mutable caller object or durable row. Failure envelopes are frozen.

future006O.visibility: H alone is a numerical historical boundary, not a visibility guarantee for a lagging unanchored reader.
future006O.requiredFlow: 006N1 -> bookmark-anchored session/read dependency -> direct 006I pages through fixed H -> 006K complete grouping -> 006L anchored exact durable resolution -> 006M composition.
future006O.laterWrites: Later target-SKU appends can coexist with reconstruction through H under immutable ledger/durable evidence assumptions; no continued-currentness claim.
